thesis: ASO is extended after a 63-day run of +42%, sitting 10.9% above its SMA20 with RSI 71.8, and the technical card itself puts reward/risk at only about 1.1, which is poor compensation for a stop capped at 2.5 ATR. The two sessions since the 52-week high closed lower, so distribution after a blow-off volume day (3.6M) is a plausible read. The regime is neutral with QQQ below its 50-day, the 10-year yield near a 1-year high, and QQQ 0.85 points from the -8% risk-off line, so a market shock would hit an extended name hard. Earnings on 2026-12-08 add event risk if the hold runs long. Wait for a deeper pullback or a volume breakout above 71.29.
